description.en: Creates a detailed (Hi) model of a match player for an in-match scene: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(6, _charaname, "dmmy", _id, _is_upper, true, false, _teamID). During a match the player is found in the match data and dressed in their match kit.
Parameter ID of the player, e.g. "para_cp0008".
Team to search: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team, 2 = search by ID only.
Handle of the new character (see CMND_CREATE_CHARA).

examples.case: A close-up of a player in a match scene (real usage, from ev44010020.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
